blocks.raw:
<Tip>
Footing = 75mm, Beam/Column = 40mm, Slab = 20mm. Memorize this "three-number rule" first. Then layer: weather exposure adds 10mm (40→50); precast interior halves it (20→10–15). Prestressed is always 25–50mm.
</Tip>
